title: HtmlEm
responsibility: Renders the native em element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlEm.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native em element; native HTML content rules still apply. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no child snippet).

outputs.name: HtmlEm
outputs.description: The actual native em element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.

errors.name: Caller content or event error
errors.description: Supplied event handlers and rendered child snippets may throw; the atom does not catch their errors. Void elements ignore the child snippet.
